zh: 叮！云端某处，一个容器开机啦！
en: Ding! Somewhere in the cloud, a container boots up!

zh: 新任务：做个像素风视频？包在我身上！
en: New task: a pixel-art video? Leave it to me!

zh: 第一步，git clone！嘿～咻！仓库到手！
en: Step one: git clone! Heave-ho! Repo acquired!

zh: 噼里啪啦写代码，每一帧都是我画的！
en: Clack-clack-clack! Every frame, drawn in code!

zh: 无头浏览器，真的没有头！咔咔咔，逐帧拍照！
en: A headless browser, literally headless! Snap, snap, snap!
FFmpeg, press! Bang, bang, bang. It's a video!
Three, two, one. Git push, liftoff!

zh: 这个视频，就是这样做出来的！容器下班啦，拜拜～
en: And that's how this video was made! Container clocking out. Bye!
